title: Embeddings Are Overpriced? A Frozen 16 MB Vocabulary for Small and Ternary Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22428v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In a small language model the vocabulary is the single largest part. In Gemma 3 270M the embedding table holds 168M of 268M parameters, and because quantisation methods leave the embedding in 16-bit, it is also most of the file once the rest of the model is compressed. We ask what that table actually buys. We replace it with one frozen table of 512-bit codes, 16 MB, with no trainable parameters, derived once from a pretrained embedding by principal-component projection and sign binarisation, and we train the same Gemma-shaped body from scratch on the same 2.05B tokens with and without it. The learned table buys 0.20 nats of validation loss for 2.6 times the trainable parameters, but on LAMBADA, HellaSwag and PIQA the frozen-table model is better or tied; only ARC-Easy favours the learned table. With a ternary BitNet b1.58 body the whole model is a 46 MB file, still ties the float model on LAMBADA and PIQA, and on a laptop CPU generates 6

translated_title: 词嵌入定价过高？面向小型与三值语言模型的16 MB冻结词表
translated_abstract: 在小型语言模型中，词表是占比最大的单一组成部分。在Gemma 3 270M中，嵌入表占据了2.68亿总参数中的1.68亿；由于量化方法通常将嵌入保留为16位，当模型其余部分被压缩后，嵌入表仍占模型文件的绝大部分。我们追问这张表究竟换来了什么。我们用一个由512位编码构成的冻结表（16 MB，不含任何可训练参数）将其替换——该表通过对预训练嵌入进行主成分投影与符号二值化一次性导出——并在相同的20.5亿token上从头训练相同Gemma结构的模型主体（分别带与不带该冻结表）进行对比。结果显示，可学习嵌入表以2.6倍的可训练参数仅换来0.20 nat的验证损失改善；而在LAMBADA、HellaSwag和PIQA上，冻结表模型表现更好或持平，只有ARC-Easy更偏好可学习表。搭配三值BitNet b1.58主体，整个模型仅为一个46 MB的文件，在LAMBADA和PIQA上仍与浮点模型持平，并且在笔记本电脑CPU上每秒可生成6……（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究用一个无任何可训练参数、仅16 MB的冻结512位二值编码词表替代可学习嵌入表，在保持甚至略优于基模型的下游任务性能的同时，大幅削减小型及三值语言模型的参数量与文件体积，使三值模型整体仅约46 MB。
